CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organizational presentation (position listing), and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-access relation to the identified content is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (color-bound position sets) are asserted with referent and time.

D.rationale: Content listings are accompanied by separate origin/record-status metadata for the same referent/time, distinguishing identification from status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented via explicit position lists (organized pattern) for the referent at current time.
